title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the Dota 2 Upper Bracket Semifinal 2 match between PARIVISION and Team Liquid in the BLAST Slam Playoffs, initially scheduled for November 27, 2026 at 5:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "PARIVISION" if PARIVISION win Game 1 against Team Liquid.

This market will resolve to "Team Liquid" if Team Liquid win Game 1 against PARIVISION.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Game 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Game 1. 

If Game 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before December 11, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of November 27, 2026 at 5:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://www.dotabuff.com. However, if https://www.dotabuff.com has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
